agent_assessment: All three gaps identified in round 1 have been fully resolved. (1) AgentsDropdown maxConcurrent prop is now properly wired from both GraphWorkspaceHUD.tsx and SidebarHeader.tsx, displaying the N/M badge format (e.g., '2/3'). (2) Circuit-broken UI indicators are implemented at three layers: red/amber pill badge on BacklogCard, pulsing red dot on graph nodes, and a governance store polling /api/v1/overview to surface circuit_broken_items. (3) Settings normalization tests now cover all 6 governance fields with comprehensive edge cases (boundary, overflow, underflow). Build compiles cleanly, all tests pass (execution + settings packages). The implementation matches the plan's Definition of Done across all dimensions: settings (API/CLI/UI), concurrency enforcement, queue depth, circuit breaker with explicit reset, cost cap, governance status visibility, and test coverage.
